schema.title: RetryRequest

get.description: M4 S7: open review cases (read-only; no decision or status route exists).

Server-sent progress events (M3 S7): node events (durable, replayable) and run
current-status events, read from PostgreSQL; Redis only wakes the stream up.
Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` to continue without gaps or duplicates.

200.description: `text/event-stream`. Each `data:` line is one ProgressEvent (event `node` or `run`); `id:` is the event id for Last-Event-ID.

Applicability.title: Applicability
Applicability.description: Status of a *requirement* (docs/03 `applicability`). Used from M3; never on chunks.

AtomicClaim.title: AtomicClaim
AtomicClaim.description:
One checkable proposition. Typed claims come from a versioned template; explanatory
claims are verbatim model sentences (never user words).

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: A cited stored chunk, copied from Postgres (never from model output).

enum: Decision support only. Not a KYC decision. Not claim-verified (M4).
Decision support only. Not a KYC decision. Where shown, claims were checked against the cited text by an automated model; this is not a legal determination.
notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Decision support only. Not a KYC decision. Not claim-verified (M4).

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Independent educational prototype. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official system of HDFC Bank.

ComplianceReport.title: ComplianceReport
ComplianceReport.description:
One report per run (M3_PLAN §5). Every report requires human review; no field can
express an approval or rejection. Holds codes and stored-source citations only:
never the question text, quoted user words or matched sensitive text.

Versions (M4_PLAN §I): `report_version` 1 is every M3 report (stored rows have no such
key, so it defaults to 1) and must keep validating unchanged; 2 is M4. A v1 report can
carry no M4 field; a v2 report's verification fields must agree with each other.

ConflictSide.title: ConflictSide
ConflictSide.description: One side of a source conflict: provenance and window offsets only (no text).

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description: docs/04 Step 0 categories (docs/14 calls the field `category`).

code.title: Code
code.description: A stable error code, e.g. SESSION_NOT_FOUND.

message.title: Message
message.description: A fixed, safe message. Never contains request input.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Screening category codes; only on SENSITIVE_DATA_DETECTED and INPUT_REJECTED.

retry_after.title: Retry After
retry_after.description: Seconds until a retry may succeed; only on some RUN_IN_PROGRESS errors (also sent as the Retry-After header).

EvidenceEligibility.title: EvidenceEligibility
EvidenceEligibility.description: Whether retrieval may use a document's chunks as compliance evidence (filter, not rank).

EvidenceJudgement.title: EvidenceJudgement
EvidenceJudgement.description:
One (claim, cited chunk) result. Provenance is copied from the stored chunk; scores
are the best window's raw logits and their softmax, in `NLI_LABELS` order.

EvidenceRole.title: EvidenceRole
EvidenceRole.description: What a cited chunk may support, derived from stored metadata (`evidence_role`).

LinkKind.title: LinkKind
LinkKind.description:
How a form field relates to a policy passage. A relationship, never an obligation
(M3_PLAN §7): links are not citations and never establish MANDATORY.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description: The single outcome of a report, in precedence order (highest first).

ProfileSummary.title: ProfileSummary
ProfileSummary.description: A profile value and its source for the report (never the user's own words).

Question.title: Question
Question.description: One targeted clarification question with its closed set of answers.

RelatedField.title: RelatedField
RelatedField.description: A form field linked (S4) to a cited passage: a relationship, never an obligation.

RequirementVerification.title: RequirementVerification
RequirementVerification.description: All of M4's work on one validated requirement, and its downgrade-only effect.

ReviewCasesResponse.title: ReviewCasesResponse
ReviewCasesResponse.description: Read-only. No decision, approval, rejection or resolution route exists.

workflow.description: The latest run of the session, or null before the first message.

SourceConflict.title: SourceConflict
SourceConflict.description:
Two passages from different documents, both naming a requirement's item, that the
model reads as contradicting each other (M4_PLAN §H). Both sides stay visible. Resolved
only by a recorded, active, confirmed supersession (D10); never by date.

SourceStatus.title: SourceStatus
SourceStatus.description: Status of a *source document* (docs/14 values plus `unknown`). Never a requirement status.

StatementAnalysis.title: StatementAnalysis
StatementAnalysis.description: Deterministic reading of one evidence window: a necessary condition, never sufficient.

TextReliability.title: TextReliability
TextReliability.description:
How far a chunk's text can be trusted as a reading of the source (Stage C policy).

OCR text is `ocr_reliable` only if its page status is `ok` AND the chunk's mean line
confidence meets the document's threshold (settings `OCR_RELIABLE_MIN_CONFIDENCE`,
overridable per manifest entry). Uncertain OCR text is preserved and retrievable but
can never support a MANDATORY requirement.

UnverifiedItem.title: UnverifiedItem
UnverifiedItem.description:
A validated requirement whose claims the cited text did not support (decision D2):
kept visible for review, out of the checklist. Never "not required".

ValidatedRequirement.title: ValidatedRequirement
ValidatedRequirement.description:
A requirement that survived `output_validation`. Its applicability is the
validator's (never above the model's proposal); its explanation is model prose.
M4 widens the two status fields; the M3 defaults are unchanged.

VerificationMeta.title: VerificationMeta
VerificationMeta.description: How verification ran: provenance and counts only (no text).

finished_at.title: Finished At
finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, or null while open.

clarification.description: Present only while `status` is awaiting_clarification (null if the pending question cannot be read).

report_id.title: Report Id
report_id.description: Present only when `status` is completed (null if no report is stored).

outcome.description: Present only when `status` is completed (null if no report is stored). No outcome approves or rejects anything.
